description: Append-only log of BREATHE cycles. Each entry records baseline/post scores, items attempted, skill effectiveness, and discoveries.

failure_reasons.validation_investigation: pathfinder passes individually (5/5 maps OK) but pipeline scorer reports 0% Ã¢â‚¬â€� likely timeout issue in batch subprocess (10s per map). Maps ARE valid but scorer can't confirm in time.

discoveries: Pipeline scorer validation stage runs pathfinder with 10s timeout per map Ã¢â‚¬â€� maps pass individually but fail in batch due to cumulative timeout. The scorer reports 0% validation even for structurally valid maps.
Primitives Lab_Death and Point_Line were missing docs. Transformation Trans_Pit was missing docs. Writing 5 doc files (2 blurb + 3 intent) advanced both sequences from stage 2 to stage 3.
Documentation gaps are the cheapest HEAD to advance Ã¢â‚¬â€� 5 small files move 2 sequences forward.

Two sequences jumped stage 3Ã¢â€ â€™5 in one breath: 3 file changes (2 registry additions + 1 typo fix). Registry gaps are the cheapest HEAD advance after documentation.
Pattern: when scorer reports 99% artifacts, there is exactly 1 artifact in a map not in the registry. Find it with layers.interactables cross-referenced against load_all_registry_scenes().

Registry files with _comment_* string values (not dicts) cause silent load failure in pipeline scorer Ã¢â‚¬â€� entire file skipped. qfep.json and transforms.json both had this. Fix: remove string-valued keys from artifacts dict.

Wrong res:// paths are common: array vs arrays directory, recursiveemergence vs fractals, light vs postprocessing. Pattern: scorer shows 95-99% for a sequence Ã¢â‚¬â€� 1-4 artifacts have stale paths from renames.

Single breathe session advanced ALL 6 stage-3 sequences to stage 5 Ã¢â‚¬â€� 19/19 sequences now at stage 5. Registry repair is the highest-leverage action when sequences are stuck at stage 3.
grade-F maps come from validate_map.py --all --json, not pathfinder --all. grade_F = json_valid failure OR has_required_fields failure.

Point_Zero had trailing comma after last structure row + blank line Ã¢â‚¬â€� standard trailing-comma JSON error. Fix: strip trailing commas iteratively before ] or }.
Registry scene path key is "scene" not "scene_path" Ã¢â‚¬â€� workbench audit uses value.get("scene") to build scene_path. Previous attempt to fix via scene_path key did nothing.

algorithms_misc.json paths for context_free_grammars, tree_generation were already correct. rorschach_* paths were already correct but files resolve and exist Ã¢â‚¬â€� workbench still flags them (bug or cache).
arrays.json used array/ (singular) prefix, actual files are in arrays/ (plural). 3 entries fixed. Pattern: directory renames leave stale registry paths.
Release gate improvement: Gate C (Map Validation) went from FAIL to PASS. Gate D was already passing. 2/4 gates now pass (was 1/4). grade_F: 2->0, unresolved_scene_files: 62->55.
Pipeline scorer avg unchanged at 4.05 Ã¢â‚¬â€� validation stage 0% is a known timeout artifact, not actual validation failures. Maps structurally valid.

Pattern: scene_path vs scene key mismatch is a common entry-format inconsistency. Check physics_simulation.json and procgen_extra.json for future entries.

Pipeline is stuck at stage 6 (VR testing) for all 18 non-randomness sequences. No AI action can advance this â€” requires human VR sessions. Garden health is the most productive improvement area until VR testing resumes.

Garden state thresholds: DORMANT < 30% voiced, SCATTERED 30-69%, REACHING >=70% voiced + <20% embodied, GROWING >=70% + 20-50% embodied, LIVING >=70% + >=50% embodied. primitives skipped REACHING because 25 already-embodied artifacts give 39% embodiment rate.

@identity needs field determines embodied vs reaching: needs all [has] and no [missing] = embodied. Artifacts genuinely missing VR features should stay [missing] â€” do not fake [has] to game the score.

discoveries: primitives.json had a trailing comma after the last maps[] entry — invalid JSON causing Gate A to return -1 for all metrics AND garden_listener to crash on sequence scan. One-line fix restored Gate A to PASS.

garden_listener cache keyed by gd.stem.lower() — PascalCase filenames like NeuralNetworks_VR.gd produce key 'neuralnetworks_vr', but map lookups use snake_case 'neural_networks_vr'. The _ between 'Neural' and 'Networks' is absent in the cache key. Fix: register normalized key (lowercase, underscores stripped) as fallback. This revealed 25 previously-invisible voiced ML artifacts in one fix.
catalyst_target is in SKIP_ARTS in garden_listener.py — voicing it does not improve garden counts but still provides pedagogical documentation value.

All 7 'missing' machinelearning artifacts (neural_networks_vr, learn_world_stacked, computer_vision_vr, etc.) already had @identity blocks — they were invisible only because of the cache key mismatch. The cache fix, not @identity writing, was the breakthrough.

PascalCase → snake_case lookup mismatch is systemic: machinelearning, cellularautomata, grammar_systems, proceduralaudio, spatial_partitioning all benefited from the normalization fix. Pattern: when garden shows a sequence 'stuck' with no obvious unvoiced files, check if filenames use PascalCase while map lookups use snake_case.
Garden cascade from single tool fix: 98 voices unlocked, 6 sequences advanced states. Infrastructure bugs hide progress more than missing content does.

discoveries: Pipeline scorer parses cell tokens with split(colon)[0], so map_data cells like mc:sphere:0:1:0.04 parse to mc (unregistered). Colon-prefixed namespace tokens cannot be made to count by adding a registry entry - they must be renamed to use underscores. Pattern: search for cells matching [a-z]+:[a-z]+: to find this class of misregistration.

Two near-duplicate .gd files (branching_growth_algorithm in branchinggrowthalgorithm/ and branchinggrowthalgorithmcontinued/) had identical @identity blocks. The continued version adds aging/phases/seasons but the identity narrative did not reflect this. Differentiating identities for code variants is a cheap fix that resolves heat-map flags without code changes.

isosurfaces sequence had 1/26 voiced - voicing the 3 directly-registered scenes (metaballs, nakama_metaballs, queer_marching_cave) advanced voiced count by 2 in the registry-bound listener. The other 23 unvoiced .gd files in algorithms/proceduralgeneration/isosurfaces/ are unregistered helper scripts (TerrainGenerator*, voxel_*); they do not appear in the garden listener cache because no registry entry points to them.

Color sequence had Chamber_Color as the only undocumented map (7/8 = 88%). Catalyst chambers have a stable structure (becoming_catalyst#start_mode + catalyst_target + proximity_spawner + science_screen) that makes their docs writable from interactables alone.

Process discovery: appending entries to breath_log.json must use ensure_ascii=True to avoid surrogate-pair encode errors from older entries that contain corrupted unicode. A failed write while the file is open truncates it - always read fully into memory before opening for write.

Pipeline scorer KeyError on empty sequences: score_sequence early-returned with only stages.1_structure populated. main() display loop unconditionally indexed stages 2-7. boolean_surfaces (0 maps) crashed the daily baseline. Fix: when maps==[], populate stages 2-7 with done=0 total=0 pct=0 before returning. Schema invariant restored.

branchinggrowthalgorithmcontinued/.tscn had a stale script path (missing 'growth_systems/' subdir) AND its uid pointed to the OTHER branchinggrowthalgorithm/.gd's uid (cdswj66fc5evr). Net effect: the 'continued' scene was silently loading the regular branching script, leaving the continued .gd (24987 bytes with aging/phases/seasons code) orphaned. Fix: rewrite ext_resource line with correct path + the file's own uid (6n96tsdpij6bc).

Wavefunctions voicing cascade: BigPipeSystem (3 maps) + seismograph (2 maps) + coupled_oscillator_lattice (1 wf + 1 advlab map) = 7 voices from 3 @identity adds. Cross-sequence leverage: coupled_oscillator_lattice voicing helps both wavefunctions AND advancedlaboratory.

Garden total voiced 903 -> 912 (+9) from 4 @identity additions. wavefunctions: SCATTERED 58/105 (55%) -> SCATTERED 64/105 (61%). randomness: SCATTERED 34/73 (47%) -> SCATTERED 36/73 (49%). advancedlaboratory: 0/4 -> 1/4 voiced.

Pattern: heat-map-flagged 'duplicate artifact files' for branching_growth_algorithm was actually a stale-uid + stale-path bug masquerading as a filename collision. The duplicate filename concerns garden cache (still present), but the runtime bug was the .tscn pointing to the wrong script. Two distinct bugs, similar surface symptoms.
